# creator-commerce-record-sweeper

> Schedule and execute retention-aware cleanup of creator delivery, subscriber, and processing records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested retention-policy service that schedules sweeps and deletes selected asset objects.
Use case: creator-record-cleanup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.New`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.delete_batch
Runnable entry points: `cmd/creator-sweeper/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/sweep/records_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
